US student visa rule change impacts Indian students

The United States has implemented a new visa regulation limiting the stay for F-1 students to four years. This change is expected to affect over 300,000 Indian students. The implications of this policy shift are being discussed, with potential impacts on Indian students' educational and immigration pathways.
